media.title: Wstąp do wojska broń Ojczyzny! — 1920
media.description: Polish army recruitment appeal of 1920, „Wstąp do wojska broń Ojczyzny!”, used as context for Kaper’s 1920 volunteer military service.
media.altText: Printed Polish appeal of 1920 calling men to join the army and defend the country.
media.rightsNote: Public domain: ephemera held by Archiwum Państwowe w Lublinie, digitised in Szukaj w Archiwach. Reproduced with attribution to Archiwum Państwowe w Lublinie.
